# homarr_board (Data Source)

Looks up a single Homarr board by `id` or by `name`. Exactly one of the two must be set.

Note that the board's column count is absent: Homarr's REST API does not expose it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "homarr_board" "infra" {
  name = "infra"
}

# Attach settings to a board that was created outside Terraform.
resource "homarr_board_settings" "infra" {
  board_id   = data.homarr_board.infra.id
  page_title = "Infrastructure"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Identifier of the board to look up.
- `name` (String) Name of the board to look up. Board names are unique in Homarr.

### Read-Only

- `creator_id` (String) Identifier of the board's creator.
- `creator_name` (String) Name of the board's creator.
- `is_home` (Boolean) Whether this is the home board of the user behind the API key.
- `is_mobile_home` (Boolean) Whether this is the mobile home board of the user behind the API key.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the board is visible without authentication.
- `logo_image_url` (String) Board logo URL.
